title: Successive paired electrochemical late-stage modification of niclosamide a common anthelmintic drug. A green protocol for the synthesis of new drug-like molecules
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17803-17810
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02025E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Haniya Rezaei, Davood Nematollahi, Niloofar Mohamadighader, Farideh Lotfipour
Novel niclosamide analogs (LSP) were synthesized via successive paired electrolysis of niclosamide (NIC) in the presence of arylsulfinic acids. This work presents a green method under mild conditions in a one-pot process.
